name: merge::resolves_merge::on_bindings
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON t.id=s.sid WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::resolves_merge::update
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET id=s.sid

name: merge::resolves_merge::insert
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,label) VALUES(s.sid,s.slabel)

name: merge::resolves_merge::defaults
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES

name: merge::resolves_merge::delete
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::resolves_merge::nothing
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DO NOTHING

name: merge::resolves_merge::by_source
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN UPDATE SET id=t.id

name: merge::resolves_merge::returning
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE RETURNING t.id,s.sid,merge_action()

name: merge::resolves_merge::star
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE RETURNING *

name: merge::resolves_merge::qualified_star
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE RETURNING t.*

name: merge::resolves_merge::correlated_update
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET id=(SELECT s.sid)

name: merge::resolves_merge::correlated_insert
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(id) VALUES((SELECT s.sid))

name: merge::resolves_merge::returning_subquery
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE RETURNING (SELECT merge_action())

name: merge::resolves_merge::row_assignment
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET (id,label)=(SELECT s.sid,s.slabel)

name: merge::resolves_merge::using_cte
sql: WITH incoming AS (SELECT 1 sid) MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET id=s.sid

name: merge::resolves_merge::using_query
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING (SELECT 1 sid) s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET id=s.sid

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::target_in_insert
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(id) VALUES(t.id)

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::nested_target_in_insert
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(id) VALUES((SELECT t.id))

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::source_by_source
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND s.sid IS NULL THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::nested_source_by_source
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND (SELECT s.sid IS NULL) THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::target_in_source
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING (SELECT t.id) s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::hidden_alias
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET id=items.id

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::unreachable
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE WHEN MATCHED THEN DO NOTHING

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::nonboolean
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON 1 WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::action_in_on
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON merge_action() IS NULL WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::action_in_when
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED AND merge_action() IS NULL THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::action_in_assignment
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET label=merge_action()

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::missing_target
sql: MERGE INTO absent t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::missing_column
sql: MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET absent=1

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::recursive
sql: WITH RECURSIVE c AS (SELECT 1) MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

name: merge::rejects_invalid_merge::cte_unreadable
sql: WITH m AS (MERGE INTO items t USING incoming s ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE) SELECT * FROM m
